The [[Citadel of Dzagon]] is the residence of one of the three [[Princes of Vabbi|Merchant Prince]]s of [[Vabbi]], Prince Ahmtur the Mighty. It lies directly adjacent to [[Dzagonur Bastion (outpost)|Dzagonur Bastion]] at the western edge of the [[Wilderness of Bahdza]]. Its powerful defenses includes [[Bombard (Vabbian)|three powerful bombard]]s that repel [[Dzalana]] invaders.
